name: Indian Acrylics Limited
about: Indian Acrylics Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of acrylic fiber, tow, and yarn products in India and internationally. The company operates in Fibre and Yarn segments. Its products include staple fibre, tows, and tops. The company's products are used in textile industry to manufacture winter wear, such as sweaters, shawls, etc., as well as work clothing, indoor and outdoor furnishing fabrics, blankets, carpets, toys, etc. It also exports its products to rest of Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Indian Acrylics Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, India.
